meta.title: Conversation remover and recycle bin
meta.description: Delete a conversation from its row menu and take with it the files it produced, the files it read, files the log names outside its working directory, its subagent conversations, and the attachments no other conversation references — or keep the conversation and delete only its files. The delete dialog folds into collapsible sections so the whole decision fits one screen; one file appears once (an attachment-store copy is folded into the file it duplicates), and anything skipped is listed with its reason. Every file can be expanded to show its source directory and the conversations behind it. Each recycle-bin group states which of its items are the conversation files and which are files that conversation produced. A deletion goes to the recycle bin and can be restored as a whole group, one file at a time, or as a multi-selection; a restored conversation goes back to its original workspace, which is re-created for that directory if its registration was deleted, and left ungrouped with a stated reason if the directory itself is gone. Retention days and a size cap are configurable. A recycle-bin entry sits at the foot of the sidebar and can be switched off on this plugin page, which also carries the hidden subagent conversations and both settings. The reversible path asks for no acknowledgement; only emptying the recycle bin, deleting permanently, and a deletion too large to store ask for one.
